recipes.name: Gourmet Pan-Seared Honey-Cinnamon Banana
recipes.instructions: Peel the banana and slice it lengthwise into two halves. Heat the butter in a small non-stick skillet over medium heat until foamy. Place the banana halves cut-side down in the skillet. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until a golden-brown crust forms. Flip the bananas. Drizzle the honey or maple syrup over the exposed sides. Sprinkle with cinnamon and salt. Cook for 1 to 2 more minutes until the syrup is slightly caramelized and bubbling. Serve immediately, scraping the pan sauce over the bananas.

recipes.name: Velvet Banana & Peanut Butter Protein Shake
recipes.instructions: If using a fresh banana, slice it into chunks before proceeding. Combine the banana, milk, peanut butter, vanilla extract, and ice cubes in a high-powered blender. Blend starting on low speed, then increasing to high, until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy. If the mixture is too thick, add milk one tablespoon at a time until desired consistency is reached. Pour into a chilled glass and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Single-Serving Banana Bread Mug Cake
recipes.instructions: Mash the entire banana thoroughly in a small bowl until completely smooth. Add the brown sugar, melted butter or oil, milk, and vanilla extract to the mashed banana and mix well. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour and baking powder. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix just until combined (do not overmix). Pour the batter into a large microwave-safe mug. Microwave on high for 60 to 90 seconds. The cake is done when the top appears set and springs back lightly. Allow to cool for 1 minute before eating directly from the mug.
